messages:
maya: Quick sync — target rollout for v2.17.0 is next Tue (2026-04-07). Need cross-region windows for US/EU/APAC and final cutoffs. Proposal: US primary window 02:00–04:00 UTC, EU warm traffic 07:00–09:00 UTC, APAC low-traffic window 18:00–20:00 UTC. Thoughts?

tom: Those windows look OK for infra. What's the branch freeze time?

maya: Freeze at 2026-04-06 23:00 UTC (1h before tag). Ask teams to finish CRs and merge-to-release by then. Any post-freeze hotfixes go through release branch with approvals.

anya: Changelog bump reminder: docs and release notes need final edits by 2026-04-06 20:00 UTC so we can generate the release page. I'll ping docs owners. :memo:

liam: Canary plan idea: start EU canary at 5% for first 20m, then 25% for 40m, then ramp to 100% if no errors. US starts with 10% then 50. APAC straight to 100% during their low-traffic window? Pros/cons?

ops-oncall: DB migration question — we have a light migration that touches user_preferences table (adds column). Is it backfill-free? If we need backfill, can't go straight to 100% in APAC.

maya: Good catch. Migration is additive and safe, no big backfill planned. But we should still gate with a feature flag and migration toggle.

liam: Then APAC can go to 100% but only after migration health checks pass and we confirm no schema locks. Sequence: deploy schema (no-lock), deploy app with migration flag off, run small verify job, flip flag, then traffic ramp.

tom: Can we get a short runbook snippet for oncall? Also add alert thresholds: 5xx rate > 0.5% or p90 latency +20% for 10m.

maya: Will add runbook. Draft here: 
```
- Freeze: 2026-04-06 23:00 UTC
- Tag: git tag v2.17.0 on 2026-04-07 00:00 UTC
- Deploy order: US (canary -> ramp) -> EU (canary -> ramp) -> APAC (full after checks)
- Canary policy: EU 5%->25%->100%, US 10%->50%->100%
- Feature flag: ff.v2.17.migration = off -> validate -> on
- DB: run `db-tool verify-schema --dry-run` before flip
- Alerts: 5xx > 0.5% OR p90 +20% for 10m -> rollback to previous tag
```

anya: Changelog checklist: highlights, migration note, migration toggle instructions, upgrade impacts. I'll compile and post the release notes doc by EOD Fri.

release-bot: Deploy checklist created: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.17.0/checklist (editable). Automated smoke tests scheduled for 2026-04-07 00:30 UTC.

ops-oncall: Confirmed: smoke tests exist and include db verify job. I'll run a dry-run on staging tomorrow morning and post results.

liam: One more — load-balancer warmup: set target_conns to 60% for first 15m to avoid sudden connection spikes. Add to runbook.

maya: Added. Also reminder for CR owners: include migration toggle instructions in PR description, example: 
```
feature_flags:
  ff.v2.17.migration: false
```

tom: Ack. I'll coordinate release-branch approvals and ensure all required CI checks are green by freeze. :white_check_mark:

anya: @maya please @mention me when you push the final tag so I can update docs and the changelog link in the release page.

maya: Will do. Last ask: if anyone can't meet these windows, ping here now so we can adjust. Otherwise proceeding with proposed timetable. :rocket:

liam: All good from infra side.

ops-oncall: Staging dry-run complete — db verify OK, smoke tests pass. No blockers reported.

maya: Great — thanks everyone. Tagging final reminder in #all-hands on Monday morning.
